title: Practice 3: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Won't you come in for a moment?
exercises.why: **зайдёшь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The dog ran away from us.
exercises.why: **убежала** — past tense (feminine) of убежать: perfective (imperfective partner: убегать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The city is hosting the fair.
exercises.why: **проводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of проводить: imperfective (perfective partner: провести).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: At what time are you leaving?
exercises.why: **уходишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of уходить: imperfective (perfective partner: уйти).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: We'll bring Tom home.
exercises.why: **привезём** — future tense (1st person plural) of привезти: perfective (imperfective partner: привозить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The dog came running to me.
exercises.why: **подбежала** — past tense (feminine) of подбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: подбегать).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: You will drive me mad.
exercises.why: **сведёте** — future tense (2nd person plural) of свести: perfective (imperfective partner: сводить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Layla escaped from Sami.
exercises.why: **убежала** — past tense (feminine) of убежать: perfective (imperfective partner: убегать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Excuse us for a minute.
exercises.why: **отойдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of отойти: perfective (imperfective partner: отходить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: The cat ran up the tree.
exercises.why: **взбежал** — past tense (masculine) of взбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: взбегать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The plane took off easily.
exercises.why: **взлетел** — past tense (masculine) of взлететь: perfective (imperfective partner: взлетать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: When does the plane leave?
exercises.why: **вылетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of вылетать: imperfective (perfective partner: вылететь).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: It wasn't part of the plan.
exercises.why: **входило** — past tense (neuter) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Call me when you get there.
exercises.why: **доедешь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of доехать: perfective (imperfective partner: доезжать).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: We pass under a bridge.
exercises.why: **проходим** — present tense (1st person plural) of проходить: imperfective (perfective partner: пройти).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: Did you spend the night with her?
exercises.why: **провела** — past tense (feminine) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: The water is waist-deep.
exercises.why: **доходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of доходить: imperfective (perfective partner: дойти).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: Everybody ran out into the hall.
exercises.why: **выбежали** — past tense (plural) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom ran out of the classroom.
exercises.why: **выбежал** — past tense (masculine) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: I crossed the street.
exercises.why: **перешла** — past tense (feminine) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).
